CapStatus.description: Outcome of the growth cap check (SPEC-0006 R8).

oneOf.description: The growth is at or below the cap.
The growth is above the cap: reported, not refused.

GrowthCapCheck.description: The perpetual growth compared with the cap the analyst gave.

cap.description: The cap given, decimal fraction per period.

growth.description: The perpetual growth checked, decimal fraction per period.

annuity_factor.description: Value at N of a first flow of 1 (the annuity factor shared with `tvm.annuity`).

discount_factor.description: (1 + r)^−n, the factor that brings the residual value from N + n to N.

flows_value.description: Value at N of the flows of periods N + 1 to N + n, in currency units.

growth_cap.description: Growth compared with the cap; `null` when no cap is given.

residual_value_discounted.description: Residual value brought to N, in currency units.

terminal_value.description:
Terminal value at N, not discounted to the valuation date, in currency units: the value
of the n flows plus the discounted residual value.
